BiblicalUsage: Badaq means to mend a breach — to repair what is broken in the house of God. Josiah's men were given money to repair the breaches of the temple, to buy timber and stone to mend what had fallen into ruin.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God loves a repaired temple, and Josiah's workmen mending the breaches are my picture of what repentance does in a life.
